body_markdown:
Public access to Glide’s new AI app builder is now open.


[Sign up](https://www.glideapps.com/new) to try GlideOS for yourself.


Start with a spreadsheet or a prompt, and GlideOS will build you an app in minutes, based on the existing data and processes you’re already using at work. Invite your team, and GlideOS becomes a collaborative workspace where you can create *and* use the tools that run your day-to-day operations.


## Join the event on August 3


On August 3rd at 1 PM EDT, join Glide’s CEO, CTO, and VP of Design for the official launch of GlideOS. You’ll see live demos from the leadership team, and get a look inside the inner workings of the new Glide, built for the AI age.


[RSVP](https://www.glideapps.com/events/glideos-launch) to attend live or receive a copy of the recording.


Create a Glide app in five minutes, for free.


[Sign Up](https://os.glideapps.dev/?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=Try+GlideOS+in+Open+Beta%2C+and+join+the+live+event+August+3)


[Glide](https://www.glideapps.com/blog/author/glide)


Glide is a no-code platform that empowers businesses to turn their spreadsheets into beautiful, intelligent apps, fast.
